meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 安装后,当你要求检查代码质量时,它会扫描仓库,按架构、一致性、类型、测试、依赖、性能、错误处理、安全、文档九个维度排查问题,产出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告,标注严重程度、预估工时与优先级,并给出来自代码文件的证据。
howto.when: 当用户要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计或架构审查,或提到“tech debt”“code health”等关键词时。

say.text: 帮我审计这个仓库的技术债,生成报告。
say.note: 会扫描九个维度并产出一份带文件引用的报告。

say.text: 检查代码库健康,列出最需要修的问题。
say.note: 会给出最重要的 5 项与快速修复清单。

say.text: 评估项目架构,按影响/工时排优先级。
say.note: 按影响与预估工时排序,便于决定先改哪里。

howto.what_en: After installation, when asked for a code quality check, it scans the repo across 9 dimensions and produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, priorities, and file citations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a codebase health check, technical debt audit, architecture review, or mentions keywords like 'tech debt', 'code health', etc.

say_en.text: Audit this repo's technical debt and generate a report.
say_en.note: Runs the 9-dimension scan and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md.

say_en.text: Run a codebase health check and list the most critical issues.
say_en.note: Highlights the top 5 priorities and quick wins.

say_en.text: Assess the project architecture and rank fixes by impact/effort.
say_en.note: Orders by impact/effort so you know what to fix first.
